title.zh: 将苏丹库达拉特省莱巴克镇萨拉曼村马里加埃格小学的名称变更为Ampad-guiabar纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Marigaeg Elementary School in Salaman, Lebak, Sultan Kudarat, to Ampad-guiabar Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Marigaeg Elementary School in Salaman, Lebak, Sultan Kudarat, to Ampad-guiabar Memorial Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Marigaeg Elementary School in Salaman, Lebak, Sultan Kudarat, thành Trường tiểu học Ampad-guiabar Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Marigaeg Elementary School in Salaman, Lebak, Sultan Kudarat, เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Ampad-guiabar Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Marigaeg Elementary School in Salaman, Lebak, Sultan Kudarat, menjadi Sekolah Dasar Ampad-guiabar Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Marigaeg Elementary School in Salaman, Lebak, Sultan Kudarat, menjadi Sekolah Rendah Ampad-guiabar Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7346_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Marigaeg Elementary School in Salaman, Lebak, Sultan Kudarat, is hereby changed to Ampad-Guiabar Memorial Elementary School.
This Act shall take upon its approval.
